original.statement: When CRDs are installed separately, operators must first bump the CRDs by applying the v0.16.1 deploy/crds/bundle.yaml and check that no error occurs, and only then upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.

decision.reason: [ev-4139b0de79e3] is the upgrade guide's "CRDs installed separately" section. It says "the first step you need to do is bump the crds" by running kubectl apply on the v0.16.1 CRD bundle, checking that no error occurs, and only then moving external-secrets to v0.16.1. That is a required operator step, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name "bump-crds" is short kebab-case built from the evidence's own words, "bump the crds".
